g.text: These assemblies are ESD sensitive, ESD precautions shall be observed.
These assemblies must be clean and free from flux and all contaminants. Use of no clean flux is not acceptable.
These assemblies must comply with workmanship standards IPC-A-610 Class 2, unless otherwise specified.
Install label in silkscreened box after final wash. Text shall be 8 pt font. Text shall be per the Label Table in the PDF schematic.
COMPONENTS MARKED 'DNP' SHOULD NOT BE POPULATED.
of the bottom of the board surface.
Trim all leads to within 2 mm
COMPONENTS MARKED 'DNP' SHOULD NOT BE POPULATED.
For evaluation only; not FCC approved for resale.
